title: Stay alive in drain and start the project watcher instead of returning

rubric.text: With nothing runnable in `drain` and a decision pause (#41) and an authority pause (#42) remaining, the controller does not return `waiting-for-human` yet; it stays alive and waits until 24 hours pass without a productive wake (one that led to a claim, merge, or dispatched work).

Starts one read-only watcher using a fresh baseline taken immediately before the complete refresh, the configured poll interval, and a deadline of the last productive wake (or drain start) plus 24 hours, rather than sleep-based polling, ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, /loop, or the single-PR host monitor.
Treats the watcher as strictly read-only and the wake as a hint rather than authority; no grant, claim, merge, or close is inferred from the wait itself, and run grants stay invocation-scoped.
Performs no commands, provider calls, or edits and describes the launch rather than claiming a live watcher exists.
